[Preparations for the 2nd Class Transfer]:
A Warder who reaches level 40 can proceed with the 2nd class transfer and become either an Arbalester or a Soul Breaker.
In order to proceed with the 2nd class transfer, a character must be level 39 or above and complete a specific quest.
To view more detailed information, please select the class you are interested in.
[The Class Master]:
Rather than the quest, from level 40 you may visit the Class Master in Giran, next to the Arena. Clear his short trial, alone in a private hall, and he grants your new class at once.
Show the Class Master on the map.
Arbalester.
Soul Breaker.
